title: Descended effective models glue with cartesian open charts
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be a singleton fpqc covering of schemes [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Let $V\to X$ carry a transport descent datum $D$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be an open covering of $V$ [def-weil-open-immersion], with $I$ in the universe of the underlying scheme spaces. Suppose each $U_i\to X$ carries a datum $E_i$ whose inclusion into $V$ intertwines its transport with $D$. Fix schemes $W_i$ over $Y$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] and maps $q_i:U_i\to W_i$ such that the square with $U_i\to X$, $W_i\to Y$, and $p$ is cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product], and $q_i$ is invariant under every transport of $E_i$. Then there exist a scheme $W_0$ over $Y$, a morphism $q_0:V\to W_0$, and open immersions $j_i:W_i\to W_0$, jointly covering $W_0$, with $j_i$ over $Y$, such that the square with edges $q_i:U_i\to W_i$, $U_i\to V$, $j_i:W_i\to W_0$, and $q_0:V\to W_0$ is cartesian for each $i$.

source.place: Descent, Tag 0AP4, proof: descended overlap opens and scheme gluing; chart-square verification made explicit

proof.text: Obtain the descended overlap schemes Z_ik, open inclusions f_ik, transition and cocycle maps, and cartesian intersection lifts r_ik from exists_descended_overlap_glue_data. This retains the overlap data which the weaker exists_glued_model_data existential forgot.

The maps q_i are base changes of p, and each r_ik is a base change of q_i, so they are fpqc singleton covers. Flatness and surjectivity make r_ik epi. Precompose the desired equality of the two structure maps Z_ik -> Y with r_ik; its cartesian-square equation, the local model squares, the source intersection pullback equation, and the transition factorization prove equality. Cancel r_ik.

Construct Scheme.GlueData G explicitly from these overlap and cocycle maps. Multicoequalizer.desc constructs G.glued -> Y from the preceding structure-map agreements; pi_desc supplies its chart equations. G.ι gives covering open embeddings. The relation G.glue_condition, composed with r_ik and the two factorization equations, shows q_i followed by G.ι i agree on U_i times_V U_k.

Use the source open covering to construct q_0 by Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms. Its chart equation is iota_glueMorphisms. Prove the missing inverse-image equality pointwise: if x maps into chart i, choose k with x in U_k. The chart equation identifies its image with G.ι k(q_k x). Scheme.GlueData.iota_eq_iff gives a point of Z_ki projecting to q_k x. The cartesian intersection square and Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback give a point of U_k times_V U_i with first projection x. The source pullback equation shows x lies in U_i. Conversely x in U_i maps into chart i by the chart equation. This works for empty index types (the cover rules out x) and empty opens.

Apply the corrected glued_model_chart_pullbacks to the constructed model, chart equations and proved inverse-image equalities, then assemble the existential witnesses. All hypotheses and the conclusion of exists_glued_effective_model_charts remain unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_glued_effective_model_charts
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y}
    (hp : Presieve.singleton p ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage Y)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V)
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens)
    (hcover : ∀ x : V.left, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (E : ∀ i, Over.DescentDatum p (Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ (U i).ι =
        (D.transport f₁ f₂ h (Over.homMk (a.left ≫ (U i).ι)
          (by simpa only [Over.mk_hom, Category.assoc] using Over.w a))).left)
    (W : I → Over Y) (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hinv : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ q i = a.left ≫ q i) :
    ∃ (W₀ : Over Y) (q₀ : V.left ⟶ W₀.left) (j : ∀ i, (W i).left ⟶ W₀.left),
      (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)) ∧
      (∀ w : W₀.left, ∃ i, ∃ z : (W i).left, j i z = w) ∧
      (∀ i, j i ≫ W₀.hom = (W i).hom) ∧
      (∀ i, IsPullback (q i) (U i).ι (j i) q₀)
